[EN] [Solo] Olivung's Beginner Cooking Class
[ES] [Solo] Clase de cocina para principiantes de Olivung
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "Okay."
[ES] "Está bien."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Go to Meren in Highwatch.
[ES] Ve con Meren a Highwatch.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Use Personal Teleport Scroll: Olivung.

[Press key to open inventory and right-click Personal Teleport Scroll: Olivung to use.]
[ES] Usa el Pergamino de teletransporte personal: Olivung.

[Presiona la tecla para abrir el inventario y haz clic derecho en el Pergamino de teletransporte personal: Olivung para usarlo.]
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Island of Dawn — Southern Checkpoint
[ES] Isla del Amanecer — Puesto de control sur
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] The cooking aroma is giving you an appetite.
[ES] El aroma de la comida te está abriendo el apetito.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Approach Olivung at the Southern Checkpoint.
[ES] Acércate a Olivung en el Puesto de control sur.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "Okay."
[ES] "Está bien."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Speak with Olivung at the Southern Checkpoint.
[ES] Habla con Olivung en el Puesto de control sur.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Bloodbound Teralith Core
[ES] Núcleo de Teralith ligado a la sangre
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Obtain a Brutal Bloodbound Teralith's Core and deliver it to Olivung.
[ES] Consigue el núcleo de un Teralith sanguinario y entrégaselo a Olivung.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Taste the Bloodbound Salad.
[ES] Prueba la ensalada de sangre.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Try the Bloodbound Salad. [Press key to open your inventory, and select the Bloodbound Salad.]
[ES] Prueba la ensalada de sangre. [Presiona la tecla para abrir tu inventario y selecciona la ensalada de sangre.]
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Obtain the first piece of the Aspiration Stone.
[ES] Consigue la primera pieza de la Piedra de la Aspiración.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Speak with Olivung at the Southern Checkpoint.
[ES] Habla con Olivung en el Puesto de control sur.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Use the first piece of the Aspiration Stone to empower the Eternal Crown. [Press key to open your inventory, and select the Aspiration Stone - First Piece.]
[ES] Usa la primera pieza de la Piedra de la Aspiración para potenciar la Corona Eterna. [Presiona la tecla para abrir tu inventario y selecciona la Piedra de la Aspiración (primera pieza).]
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Claim reward.
[ES] Reclama la recompensa.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Speak with Olivung at the Southern Checkpoint.
[ES] Habla con Olivung en el Puesto de control sur.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026
